EV-0277 — London Gazette, 3 July 1996 (p.8990) and 18 April 1997 (p.4683): Western Ground Rents Ltd’s members’ voluntary winding-up: notice to creditors (“All known Creditors have been or will be paid in full”) and final meetings on 16 May 1997 to lay an account of how “the property of the Companies have been disposed of”


Catalogue entry **EV-0277** of the Great House Farm evidence register, carried over from the Legal Wiki evidence page last modified on 2026-10-23. The same record is published at `research.bucklerfamily.estate <https://research.bucklerfamily.estate/evidence/ev-0277-london-gazette-1996-1997-western-ground-rents-creditors-and-final-meetings/>`__, and this version is also a `PDF <https://wayback.bucklerfamily.estate/pdf/docs-archive/ghf_evidence/ev_0277/en/2026-10-23_EV-0277_ghf_evidence-ev_0277_en_v1-0-0.pdf>`__ in the wayback archive.
